chapters.title: The Silent Wheel
chapters.summary_dm: Goblins have taken the mill. Their leader is in the cellar.

locations.name: Mill Road
locations.read_aloud: A muddy lane climbs toward a watermill. The wheel is still, and no smoke rises from the chimney.
locations.description_public: The lane up to the mill.
locations.dm_notes: Nothing watches the road. The yard is where the goblins wait.

locations.name: Mill Yard
locations.read_aloud: Broken carts slump beside a cold forge. Flour dust coats the stones.
locations.description_public: A yard of carts and a dead forge.
locations.dm_notes: Three goblins hide behind the carts. Tracks of a heavy creature lead to a cellar hatch under the woodpile.

features.name: Tracks
features.public: Cart ruts and boot prints cross the yard.

hidden.reveal: A heavy set of tracks ends at a hatch under the woodpile.

locations.name: Grinding Floor
locations.read_aloud: Millstones stand in a dim room. A man is tied to a beam, and the air smells of wet grain.
locations.description_public: The grinding room and a tied miller.
locations.dm_notes: Oswin is frightened but friendly. A loose millstone drops if anyone crosses the middle of the floor. He says the goblins answer to the big one below.

features.name: Millstones
features.public: Two round stones sit in a wooden frame.

locations.name: Flour Cellar
locations.read_aloud: Damp sacks of flour slump against the walls. Water ticks somewhere in the dark.
locations.description_public: A low cellar stacked with flour sacks.
locations.dm_notes: The bugbear and two wolves lair here. The sack in the corner holds the mill's coin and two red vials.

features.name: Flour sacks
features.public: Most of the sacks are split and sour.

encounters.tactics_dm: They wait behind the carts and loose arrows if the party hesitates.
The wolves rush the nearest foe. The bugbear follows.
The swarm boils out of a split sack and bites the closest creature.

actions.name: Bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

npcs.name: Oswin
npcs.public: A flour-dusted man tied to a beam. He whispers that the goblins answer to the big one below.
npcs.dm_only: Oswin will bar the mill door if the party frees him. He has no weapon.
